tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with the States, shall establish a cooperative program for research, development, demonstration, and deployment of technologies in which there is a common Federal and State energy efficiency, renewable energy, and fossil energy interest, to be known as the “State Technologies Advancement Collaborative” (referred to in this section as the “Collaborative”).

children.text: leverage Federal and State funding through cost-shared activity;
reduce redundancies in Federal and State funding; and
create multistate projects to be awarded through a competitive process.

tree.heading: Administration
tree.text: The Collaborative shall be administered through an agreement between the Department and appropriate State-based organizations.

tree.heading: Funding sources
tree.text: Funding for the Collaborative may be provided from—

children.text: amounts specifically appropriated for the Collaborative; or
amounts that may be allocated from other appropriations without changing the purpose for which the amounts are appropriated.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to carry out this section such sums as are necessary for each of fiscal years 2006 through 2010.
